'''Iri-Do Sahn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who competed in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]<ref name="TOR:KfaD" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> He was disqualified in his sleep, and his [[Hunter (individual)|competition]] successfully completed the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Corwin]].<ref name="TOR:KfaD" />
